intro.text: A bridge in the Forests of Hell, put up to replace the Old Bridge.

items.text: When years of use had left the Old Bridge in poor shape, the fortfolk pulled it down and built the New Bridge across the chasm instead. In time the New Bridge fell into the chasm, and local homesteaders raised the Old Bridge again. Its timbers still lie at the bottom, which some see as a picture of fort promises: fine at first, but sure to give way.
